attributes.title: 2027 PPA Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Pennsylvania Pharmacists Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference from Friday, February 5 to Sunday, February 7, 2027, in Harrisburg. Registration is open for pharmacists, associates and technicians, with a separate student registration, and the conference includes an exhibit hall, a poster session, the student OTC competition and the association's awards.

PPA's schedule at a glance (as of November 17, 2026, subject to change) lists concurrent CE sessions on cholesterol and cardio-kidney-metabolic guidelines, the ADA diabetes standards, contraceptive access, a 2027 immunization update, UTI guidelines, anticoagulation and precepting, plus technician-focused sessions such as The Technician Awakens. DSMES and DPP master trainer workshops run alongside. Total CE hours and registration fees are not shown on the public pages yet.

Rooms in PPA's Hilton block must be booked by January 14, 2027 (group code PPA27).
